answer: A numbered willow board stands in a sunny courtyard; a comet burned into it is the proof. At noon the holder focuses sunlight through a quartz lens and burns one comet-shaped mark into the board, photographed with the date. Two verifiers visit within 24 hours and match the burn and the board number; a board never burned there, or a duplicate number, locks the account and burns its deposit. One burn is cheap; 100 fakes need 100 lenses, 100 trips.
